description: This file defines a terminal-based test reporter class for the Playwright testing framework, including output formatting, error handling, and summary generation.

classes.name: TerminalReporter
classes.description: A terminal-based test reporter implementing the ReporterV2 interface, responsible for outputting test results, summaries, and handling test events.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TerminalReporter with optional configuration options.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the reporter version identifier ('v2').

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Sets the full test configuration.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Called at the start of a test suite; initializes total test count.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles stdout output during tests.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles stderr output during tests.

methods.name: _appendOutput
methods.description: Stores output chunks associated with test results.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Updates failure count and duration info when a test ends.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Records fatal errors encountered during testing.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the test run, storing the full result.

methods.name: fitToScreen
methods.description: Adjusts a line to fit within the terminal width.

methods.name: generateStartingMessage
methods.description: Creates a message indicating the start of test execution.

methods.name: getSlowTests
methods.description: Retrieves slow test files based on duration thresholds.

methods.name: generateSummaryMessage
methods.description: Creates a summary message based on test outcomes.

methods.name: generateSummary
methods.description: Generates a detailed summary of test results.

methods.name: _printFailures
methods.description: Outputs failure details.

methods.name: _printSlowTests
methods.description: Outputs information about slow test files.

methods.name: _printSummary
methods.description: Outputs the overall test summary.

methods.name: willRetry
methods.description: Determines if a test will be retried based on its outcome.

methods.name: formatTestTitle
methods.description: Formats the test title for display.

methods.name: formatTestHeader
methods.description: Formats the test header, including error path if needed.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Formats detailed failure information for a test.

methods.name: formatError
methods.description: Formats an error message with stack trace and location.

methods.name: formatResultErrors
methods.description: Formats errors from test results.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Outputs a line to the terminal.

methods.name: formatResultFailure
methods.description: Creates detailed error messages for test failures.

methods.name: quotePathIfNeeded
methods.description: Quotes file paths if they contain spaces.

methods.name: markErrorsAsReported
methods.description: Marks errors in a test result as reported.

methods.name: prepareErrorStack
methods.description: Parses and prepares a stack trace for display.

methods.name: groupAttachments
methods.description: Groups related test attachments for display.
